name: ai-research-accelerator
description: An author-first workflow for accelerating research from experiment planning and analysis through top-conference publication.

interface.shortDescription: AI for accelerating research end to end.
interface.longDescription: Monitor long research tasks without continuous agent polling, plan formal experiments, analyze and plot results, write insight-driven papers, and process author review through a reproducible workflow.
defaultPrompt: Shape my evidence into an insightful paper story.
Process author feedback on this paper PR.
Audit my paper experiments and figures.
Monitor this long-running research task without continuous agent polling.
